subtitle: Cross-reference for 28/Sep/2026: Polymarket in the confirmed reading of 28/Sep, 13:49 BRT, the two national polls released on 28/Sep, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) BR-06520/2026 and BTG/Nexus BR-07557/2026, the six of 24/Sep as the previous week and the press flow of 27 and 28/Sep.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 41.50% (USD 12.52M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, down 1.00pp raw and 0.92pp normalized, confirmed reading of 28/Sep, 13:49 BRT. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he falls 0.90pp, to 24.55% (USD 1.07M). POLL: 39% to 34% in the first round and 42% to 42% in the second in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep; 42% to 37% and 46% to 44% in BTG/Nexus of the same day.
fortes: ⭐ The two national polls of 28/Sep measure him better than the same pollster's 21/Sep wave: in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) he goes from 37% to 39% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and from 41% to 42% in the second, moving from 1 point behind to a tie; in BTG/Nexus he goes from 40% to 42% in the first round.

In BTG/Nexus of 28/Sep he leads the five second-round pairings the pollster tested: 46% to 44% against Flávio Bolsonaro, 46% to 42% against Ronaldo Caiado, 46% to 41% against Augusto Cury, 48% to 39% against Romeu Zema and 48% to 37% against Renan Santos.
Government approval in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) rose for the second wave in a row, from 44% to 46%, and disapproval went from 50% to 49%, both within the margin.

🔒 Datafolha of 24/Sep measures how locked in the choice is ten days before the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): 80% of the electorate say they are completely decided, and among his voters the figure is 87%, the highest on either side.
fracos: Falls 1.00pp in the winner contract, to 41.50%, and the gap widens from 14.75pp to 16.55pp, the third widening in a row between confirmed readings. Normalized by the pair sum, which fell from 99.75 to 99.55, the loss is 0.92pp.
In the series recorded since 14 April his price sits 26.00pp from the top, 67.50% on 16/Aug, and 7.00pp from the floor, 34.50% on 25/Apr.

⚖️ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep the second-round vote transfer from the other names goes more to his opponent: of Romeu Zema's voters, 9% would go to him and 81% to Flávio Bolsonaro; of Renan Santos's, 23% and 48%; of Ronaldo Caiado's, 30% and 42% (O Globo).
In BTG/Nexus of 28/Sep his rejection is 48%, and government disapproval is above approval in both national polls of the day, 49% against 46%.
candidates.analise: Lula fell 1.00pp in the winner contract, to 41.50% (USD 12.52M cumulative volume), in the confirmed reading of 28/Sep, 13:49 BRT, and 0.92pp normalized, because the pair sum fell from 99.75 to 99.55; with that the gap widens from 14.75pp to 16.55pp, the third widening in a row between confirmed readings. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he falls 0.90pp, to 24.55%. 🗳️ The two national polls released on the morning of 28/Sep, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) (BR-06520/2026, n=2,004, fieldwork from 24 to 27/Sep) and BTG/Nexus (BR-07557/2026, n=2,000, fieldwork from 25 to 27/Sep), measure him better than the week before: 39% to 34% and 42% to 42% in Quaest, after 37% to 33% and 41% to 42%, and 42% to 37% and 46% to 44% in BTG/Nexus, after 40% to 37% and 46% to 45%. The shifts are within the margin of 2pp. ⚖️ The price moved the other way between the confirmed readings of 27 and 28/Sep, with both polls already published. ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the news: it measures both sides with the timestamp of each.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 58.05% (USD 12.14M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, up 0.80pp raw and 0.92pp normalized, confirmed reading of 28/Sep, 13:49 BRT. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he stays at 74.50% (USD 1.25M). POLL: 34% in the first round and 42% in the second, tied, in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep; 37% and 44% in BTG/Nexus of the same day.
fortes: Rises 0.80pp in the winner contract, to 58.05%, and the gap widens from 14.75pp to 16.55pp, the third widening in a row between confirmed readings. Normalized, the rise is 0.92pp, larger than the raw one, because the pair sum fell.
His price is 3.65pp from the top of the series, 61.70% recorded on 21/Sep.

⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep the second-round vote transfer from the other names favours him: 81% of Romeu Zema's voters, 48% of Renan Santos's, 42% of Ronaldo Caiado's and 34% of Augusto Cury's would go to him (O Globo).
📺 On 27/Sep, in Goiânia, he confirmed that he will attend the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct even without Lula, changing the position the campaign had been taking (O Globo, G1 and Poder360).

⭐ He leads the second-round pairing in four of the six national polls of 24/Sep, from the previous week: 49.4% to 43.7% at Futura, 48% to 45% at Palver, 46% to 45% at PoderData and 45% to 44% at Real Time, with a tie at 43% at Alfa.
fracos: Loses the numerical second-round lead in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest): on 21/Sep he had 42% to 41% and on 28/Sep the two are tied at 42%.

Trails in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in both national polls of 28/Sep, by 5 points in each: 34% to 39% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) and 37% to 42% in BTG/Nexus. In BTG/Nexus he also loses the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), by 44% to 46%, within the margin.
In BTG/Nexus of 28/Sep his rejection is 51%, the highest among the candidates, against 48% for Lula.

⚖️ On 27/Sep Supreme Court justice Flávio Dino, in a single-justice ruling, overturned André Mendonça's order at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) that required the deletion of a post by comedian Antonio Tabet about Our Lady of Aparecida, and on 28/Sep, after an appeal by Flávio Bolsonaro's defence, sent the ruling for full-court review (Jovem Pan, Brasil 247, G1 and Folha de S.Paulo).

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation. Part of the conversations concerns the financing of the film Dark Horse, and he confirmed an exchange from September 2025 about it, citing a private financing contract that was not made public.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro rose 0.80pp in the winner contract, to 58.05% (USD 12.14M cumulative volume), in the confirmed reading of 28/Sep, 13:49 BRT, and 0.92pp normalized, because the pair sum fell from 99.75 to 99.55. With that the gap widens from 14.75pp to 16.55pp, the third widening in a row between confirmed readings, and his price is 3.65pp from the top of the series, 61.70% on 21/Sep. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he stays at 74.50% raw, up 0.68pp normalized. 🗳️ The two national polls released on the morning of 28/Sep, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) (BR-06520/2026, n=2,004, fieldwork from 24 to 27/Sep) and BTG/Nexus (BR-07557/2026, n=2,000, fieldwork from 25 to 27/Sep), put him 5 points behind in the first round, and in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) tied at 42% in Quaest and 2 points behind in BTG/Nexus; Quaest measures that the votes of the other names would go more to him than to Lula in the second round. 📺 On 27/Sep he confirmed attendance at the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct. ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the news: it measures both sides with the timestamp of each.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.05% in the winner contract (USD 5.12M cumulative volume) and 45.10% (USD 0.29M cumulative volume) in the third-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), up 0.70pp raw and 0.17pp normalized by the book sum, in the confirmed reading of 28/Sep, 13:49 BRT. POLL: 4% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) and 5% in BTG/Nexus of 28/Sep.
fortes: ⭐ Stays ahead of Renan Santos in the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) for the second confirmed reading in a row: rises 0.70pp raw, to 45.10%, and the distance stands at 2.10pp.

📺 He is one of the four guests at the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct, with Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro and Ronaldo Caiado, and Renan Santos was left out under the legal criterion of congressional representation (Folha de S.Paulo).
In BTG/Nexus of 28/Sep he ties with Ronaldo Caiado at 5% and is ahead of Renan Santos, with 4%.
fracos: His lead in the third-place book narrows from 2.90pp to 2.10pp, and normalized by the book sum, which rose from 101.90 to 103.10, his rise is only 0.17pp.
Falls from 6% to 4% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) against the pollster's 21/Sep wave, and from 6% to 5% in BTG/Nexus, tied with Ronaldo Caiado in both.

In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 38% of his voters would cast a blank or null vote or not vote in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), 34% would go to Flávio Bolsonaro and 27% to Lula (O Globo).
In the winner contract he remains at the floor of the book, 0.05%, and is priced below what his cumulative volume would suggest, USD 5.02M.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury rose 0.70pp raw in the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), to 45.10% (USD 0.29M cumulative volume), in the confirmed reading of 28/Sep, 13:49 BRT, and 0.17pp normalized, because the book sum rose from 101.90 to 103.10, and stays ahead of Renan Santos, now by 2.10pp. The distance, in the series of confirmed readings, was 19.95pp, 5.25pp, 3.05pp, 4.15pp, 4.05pp, 4.45pp and 4.15pp with Renan Santos ahead, and 2.90pp and 2.10pp with Augusto Cury ahead. 🗳️ In the two national polls of 28/Sep he has 4% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), after 6% on 21/Sep, and 5% in BTG/Nexus, tied with Ronaldo Caiado in both. 📺 He is one of the four guests at the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct.
